title: lsb-vision-pipeline: a modular computer-vision architecture for converting controlled multi-arena video assays into behavioral phenotyping data
description: Computer-vision pipeline for automated behavioral phenotyping of Tenebrio molitor larvae in multi-arena Petri-dish assays: Petri detection and arena assignment, larva segmentation and tracking on per-dish crops, Petri-normalised trajectories, kinematics, occupancy heatmaps, behavioral features, quality control and FAIR-structured export with provenance. Model weights are not included.
